items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw image 1, the laser game-card edit target, retaining original SQUARE composition closely. One small elongated double-pointed silver-gray diamond crystal floats just below center, about 14 percent of picture width and 25 percent of height. Its top pyramidal half is pale ivory-silver, bottom pyramidal half darker charcoal cool-gray, both with a few clearly separated large triangular crystal planes and sharp top and bottom points. A very narrow straight white beam with a pale cyan rim extends vertically from the crystal's central/top area straight UP and exits TOP frame. Sparse short warm ivory-gold electrical sparks branch outward around the crystal toward both sides. Preserve original crystal size, position, beam thickness and direction, large negative space and pale muted cool gray backdrop. No characters, hands, weapons, extra crystals or scenery. Images 2, 3, 4 are DRAWING STYLE references only; borrow broad opaque hand-painted construction, never subjects or costume motifs. Rough hand-painted anime color study with large connected opaque masses, a few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, handmade edges and selective unfinished areas. Crystal volume through a few broad silver, ivory, blue-gray and charcoal planes, economical selective bright edges, no micro-facet mosaic or photographic glass reflections. Beam thin clean and bright; sparks a handful of decisive pale gold broken strokes with small bright centers, no dense web of fine lines. Mostly matte muted colored grays, quiet background, clearly grouped hard-edged light and shadow. No glossy 3D, photorealism, uniformly thin vector outlines or all-over grain/texture filters. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
